uzo.purpose: Separates groups of content where space alone does not.

instead.kialo: Where space alone tells the groups apart, a line adds noise, because every line asks to be read as a boundary; the container owns the space (spacing-owned-by-container), and a person decides whether the groups need more than it.

boundary.kialo: A line with a word in it is a heading of the group below or a choice between two ways, because the word carries the meaning and the line only frames it; a person decides whether it is a titolo or two paths.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A section of a page separates its groups with a line where the space between them is already taken, because the eye needs one edge to stop at.

with.kialo: A line between groups of a menu says that the entries above and below belong to different things, because a person reads a group before the next.
A line between the disclosures of a group says where one entry ends and the next begins.

case.de: Über der Gruppe soll ein Wort stehen, das sie benennt.
case.en: A word above the group should name it.

case.de: Der Inhalt über ein Ding soll als eigene Einheit mit Überschrift stehen.
case.en: The content about one thing should stand as a unit of its own with a heading.

do.de: Ziehe die Linie nur, wo der Abstand allein die Gruppen nicht mehr trennt.
do.en: Draw the line only where space alone no longer separates the groups.

do.de: Nimm emphasis high zwischen Abschnitten und low innerhalb einer Karte.
do.en: Use emphasis high between sections and low inside a card.

do.de: Setze decorative, wenn die Linie nur schmückt; ohne decorative wird sie als Trenner gehört.
do.en: Set decorative when the line only decorates; without decorative it is heard as a separator.

dont.de: Ein Wort in die Linie schreiben, denn das Wort wäre eine Überschrift.
dont.en: Write a word into the line, because the word would be a heading.

dont.de: Mehrere Linien stapeln, um eine Grenze stärker zu machen; dafür gibt es emphasis high.
dont.en: Stack several lines to make a boundary stronger; emphasis high is there for that.

none.de: Die Trennlinie nimmt weder den Fokus noch eine Taste, sie gliedert nur.
none.en: The separator takes neither the focus nor a key; it only divides.
